purpose: Machine-readable commercial feature truth for ANPOS. This catalog separates implemented protocol/runtime capabilities from partial, planned, capability-dependent, externally unlaunched, and contract-only promises so packages cannot be marketed as operational without evidence.
commercial_readiness_rule: An entitlement or product capability may exist in source before it is operationally launched, but it must not be represented as launch-ready customer value until its availability state and evidence support that claim. External activation/E2E, planned, partial, capability-dependent, or contract-only features require explicit qualification at sale time.

entitlements.notes: Archive-first private-template delivery is implemented and is bound to an operator-configured exact vendor-repository commit. The service verifies the deterministic template EXPORT-MANIFEST before redirecting a licensed customer to that immutable release. External private-repository setup and production E2E are still required before sale activation.

Paid accounts with protocol_update_channel can request the current certified release metadata after server-side entitlement reconciliation. Release metadata is derived from the deterministic private-template EXPORT-MANIFEST at an exact 40-character vendor commit SHA; mutable branch refs are rejected. Actual sale activation still depends on verified private vendor repositories, production deployment, Marketplace configuration and E2E evidence.

Canonical source defines the private Premium Pack manifest/verifier and entitlement-gated immutable release/archive plumbing. Higher paid plan activation fails closed without a distinct private premium repository, exact commit SHA, and offline-verifier manifest/content-set digests. No real private premium repository or premium blueprint payload is evidenced and no production premium E2E has passed, so this entitlement remains planned_not_implemented and must not be marketed as active customer value.

Canonical source defines provider-specific premium adapter verification plus entitlement-gated immutable premium distribution, including provider/API evidence, capability mapping, no-secret provenance and no partnership/certification claim by default. No real private premium provider adapter payload or live provider/production E2E is evidenced, so this entitlement remains planned_not_implemented.
Repository-side orchestration protocol exists. No ANPOS-operated hosted orchestrator service is currently implemented or launch-certified.

Organization seat assignment/revocation, active-member verification, capacity enforcement, principal-bound entitlements, authenticated organization-admin summary, seat usage/capacity display, and customer-facing assign/revoke UI are implemented in source. Availability remains partial: no real Team Marketplace plan/pricing is activated, production organization E2E is not verified, Marketplace purchase/plan-change/cancellation UX evidence is incomplete, Pro premium dependencies remain unimplemented because real premium payload/provider assets and production E2E are still absent, and commercial support/SLA is still an external operator contract.

Developer self-service onboarding documentation does not create a staffed support entitlement. Team/Enterprise commercial support scope, channels, hours, response targets, exclusions, privacy handling and any SLA remain operator-controlled contractual/operational commitments and are not activated by repository code.
The orchestration protocol is present, but neither a vendor-hosted service nor an enterprise self-hosting distribution/support package is currently productized.
ANPOS has strong policy foundations, but an enterprise-only policy pack, administration surface, organization rollout model, and contractual support boundary are not yet separately implemented.
Priority support or SLA exists only when the operator deliberately offers, operationally supports, approves and contracts it. Canonical source contains no numeric SLA commitment.

core_product_capabilities.notes: Standard PM/AI provider compatibility and host-dependent attachment contracts are core ANPOS behavior, not a paid entitlement. The compatibility matrix distinguishes Linear's dedicated synchronization blueprint from generic contract-only providers and keeps every live connection/provider-specific execution claim runtime-evidence-dependent. Dedicated premium adapters may be sold only when separately implemented, versioned, tested, and evidenced.

Source now defines a self-service Developer onboarding journey for entitlement refresh, certified release discovery, immutable archive delivery, provenance and runtime-dependent provider troubleshooting. The guide is not live onboarding evidence until the paid Marketplace and production flows exist. It deliberately creates no staffed support/SLA commitment.

Community source implements Marketplace Setup -> PKCE GitHub App OAuth -> installation-bound repository discovery -> read-only ten-control-file audit with encrypted short-lived browser sessions. It remains externally unlaunched until a real Marketplace App/configuration passes production E2E and operator activation.

GitHub Repository Supervisor source includes deterministic full planning, sandbox-backed full apply, and guarded empty-repository bootstrap. Empty repositories require explicit confirmation, one deterministic zero-parent .anpos-bootstrap-seed root commit to satisfy GitHub initialization semantics, sandbox-verified ANPOS output on an anpos/* feature branch that removes the seed, PR/CI review, and recovery-required state after any post-seed failure. Manual/migration conflict resolution, live gateway/GitHub E2E, public plugin activation and GitLab parity remain incomplete.
